text:
maya: Heads up — the JS onboarding sample fails when deployed to Cloudflare Workers if you build the ESM bundle with the sample tsconfig. TS complains about overlapping overloads and then at runtime the request loses Authorization. Anyone seen this?
ryan: Yikes. I reproduced: tsc error TS2345 from the sdk types — looks like two ambient type copies are present and one overload expects unknown, the other any. Compiler can't resolve.
maya: Repro snippet in sample index.ts: ```ts
import Redwood from 'redwood';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('RW_KEY') });
await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hi' }] });
```
sam: Root cause: different moduleResolution strategies (bundler vs node) + package layout mean TS can resolve the declaration file from both dist/esm and dist/cjs paths. That duplicates the overload set.
hannah: I ran into it too — my worker template used "moduleResolution": "bundler" (to match our esbuild config). Switching to "node" in tsconfig removed the duplicate types for me.
ryan: Another mitigation is to add a top-level "types" entry in package.json pointing to a single .d.ts and add "typesVersions" to collapse paths for different TS versions. That should make ESM/CJS consumers see the same typedef shape.
sam: Workaround for customers: set skipLibCheck in sample tsconfig or pin the SDK to one copy with pnpm/lockfile, but we should fix sample UX.
maya: Also saw auth header drop: in ESM worker runtime our header-injection path that mutates the Request object in the CJS code path isn't executed. So some builds shipped without Authorization. Quick workaround: set header via client.options.headers or configure the env var REDWOOD_API_KEY in the worker.
hannah: I'll add a smoke test to infra that deploys the sample to the edge emulator and asserts the Authorization header was proxied to our test endpoint.
ci-bot: Created issue RW-3499: "edge-sample: ts duplicate types + missing auth header on ESM bundles" assigned to @sam
sam: Plan: 1) update sample tsconfig to recommend moduleResolution=node + skipLibCheck=false; 2) adjust package.json exports/types to a single public typedef; 3) patch SDK to normalize header injection for both ESM and CJS entrypoints; 4) add CI matrix that compiles sample with node/bundler/module systems and runs the header smoke test.
maya: I'll open the PRs for sample and docs. Add a note to onboarding guide about explicit generic casts if inference picks the wrong overload (e.g., client.chat.create<MyType>(...)).
hannah: I'll add the CI job and a tiny worker test.
ryan: Good call. Also add a lint rule or script in devex that detects multiple copies of @redwood/sdk in node_modules during sample builds.
sam: Thanks — summary posted in RW-3499 with repro and suggested fixes. We'll keep this thread for follow ups.
